task.question: What was the highest closing price ever recorded for ticker 'TCS'?

result.question: What was the highest closing price ever recorded for ticker 'TCS'?
result.cited_sql: SELECT MAX(p.close) as highest_close FROM prices p JOIN instruments i ON p.instrument_id = i.instrument_id WHERE i.ticker = 'TCS'
